stories.title: Reformas de desconexión digital y transparencia salarial se votarán en Comisión del Senado

en.title: Digital Disconnection and Wage Transparency Reforms to be Voted on in Senate Commission
en.summary: Two reforms on digital disconnection and wage transparency, previously approved by the Chamber of Deputies, will be voted on this week in the Senate Labor Commission with transition periods included.

stories.title: Noel León espera que la F2 en México acerque a empresas y pilotos; pide apoyo

en.title: Noel León Hopes Formula 2 in Mexico Will Attract Companies and Drivers; Seeks Support
en.summary: The arrival of Formula 2 to Mexico could provide opportunities for domestic companies to gain greater exposure to motorsport, according to Noel León's statement.

stories.title: Cinco Pueblos Mágicos para conocer por su comida

en.title: Five Magical Pueblos to Visit for Their Cuisine
en.summary: Several Mexican Magic Towns preserve local culinary traditions from dishes like Pátzcuaro's corundas to Valladolid's longaniza, offering cultural food experiences alongside scenic attractions.

stories.title: Se entrega médico que provocó en Sonora la muerte de ocho personas tras inyectarles sueros vitaminados

en.title: Doctor Surrenders in Sonora After Deaths of Eight People from Vitamin Serum Injections
en.summary: A physician turned himself in to authorities in Sonora following deaths linked to vitamin serum injections he administered, with prosecutors prioritizing victims' rights despite the suspect's health condition.

stories.title: ¿Qué impulsó a Flávio Bolsonaro a ser el favorito a la presidencia de Brasil?

en.title: What drove Flávio Bolsonaro to become the favorite for Brazil's presidency?
en.summary: Former president Jair Bolsonaro, a leading figure in Brazilian right-wing politics, endorsed his son for the presidency less than a year after being sentenced to 27 years in prison for attempting a coup against Lula.

stories.title: Presidente de Irán dice que negociaciones con EU son "inútiles"

en.title: President of Iran says negotiations with US are "useless"
en.summary: Iran's president dismissed talks with the United States as futile, while Washington has recently shifted toward economic pressure rather than military operations.

en.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan activate joint defense pact; occurs amid Houthi offensive in Yemen
en.summary: Member states of a new defense alliance strongly condemned Houthi attempts to attack the holy cities of Mecca and Medina amid escalating regional tensions.

stories.title: Turquía y Pakistán desplegarán fuerzas en Arabia Saudita ante conflicto con los hutíes

en.title: Turkey and Pakistan will deploy forces in Saudi Arabia amid conflict with Houthis
en.summary: Turkey and Pakistan will conduct rapid military deployments to Saudi Arabia under a new defense alliance as the kingdom faces increased attacks from Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen.

stories.title: PAN celebra ventaja de Flávio Bolsonaro en elecciones de Brasil; “están en el basurero de la historia”, revira Morena

en.title: PAN celebrates Flávio Bolsonaro's advantage in Brazilian elections; Morena responds "they are in the dustbin of history"
en.summary: Mexico's PAN party expressed support for Brazilian politician Flávio Bolsonaro, stating he has an ally in their party. Morena responded with criticism of the opposition party.

stories.title: Dice Irán que negociaciones con EU son 'inútiles'

en.title: Iran says negotiations with US are 'futile'

en.summary: Jesús Verduzco, a physician implicated in eight patient deaths related to 'vitamin serums,' turned himself in to authorities in Sonora.
